actions.name: editCompositionLayout

semantic: Edits spacing, cross axis alignment, or outer padding on an existing composition. columns changes wrapping only on a facet composition and is rejected for concat. Composition ownership and child identity are structurally copied into the returned program.
graphic: Rebuilds the parent composition snapshot from complete child graphical specifications without mutating any child program.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.

actions.name: facet
actions.summary: Repeats one complete chart by a field on its common row preserving dataset ancestor.
useWhen: Use this action when you need to repeat one complete chart by a field on its common row preserving dataset ancestor.
avoidWhen: Avoid this action when the facet field is missing, the child cannot be replayed safely, or a fixed manual composition is the intended layout.
requiredState: The referenced child or facet owner must be a complete stored program, and every target identifier must resolve to one exact composition resource.

parameterNotes.description: Assigns a stable resource identifier so later actions can target this exact owner without relying on inference.
Names the source dataset used by this action instead of relying on the current or uniquely compatible dataset.
Names the source-row field whose values drive this action's semantic or graphical result.
Controls the axes, grids, and legends created for the completed result; false suppresses guide creation.

semantic: Repeats one complete chart by a field on its common row preserving dataset ancestor. Composition ownership and child identity are structurally copied into the returned program.
graphic: Rebuilds the parent composition snapshot from complete child graphical specifications without mutating any child program.

notes: Compose this action only after its required state is unambiguous; use explicit public identifiers when several compatible resources exist.
